source.author: verg
source.text: Ceu septem surgens sedatis amnibus altus per tacitum Ganges aut pingui flumine Nilus cum refluit campis et iam se condidit alveo.
source.text_original: Ceu septem surgens sedatis amnibus altus / per tacitum Ganges aut pingui flumine Nilus / cum refluit campis et iam se condidit alveo.
source.text_english: As the lofty Ganges rising amid its seven tranquil streams, or the Nile with its rich flood, when it ebbs back over the plains and has now confined itself within its channel.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: a quotiens famulo notis soror obvia silvis flevit, ubi Ossaeae captaret frigora quercus perderet et pingui miseros Boebeide crines.
reuse.text_original: a quotiens famulo notis soror obvia silvis / flevit, ubi Ossaeae captaret frigora quercus / perderet et pingui miseros Boebeide crines.
reuse.text_english: Ah, how often in the known woods did his sister, meeting the servant, weep, when he would seek the cold shade of the Ossaean oak and lose the miserable locks on the fertile Boebeis.
